author: MiniWarGaming
description:
Dave attempts to battle the Black Legion but can he withstand the prowess of a tournament with more than 40 games  under his belt? Can he discover what makes Black Legion viable for 11th edition of Warhammer 40K? And will he have fun in the process? Experience the banter-filled episode of Dave learning this new edition.
